liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Victim or the Crime** (1 review): Singled out as the worst second-set example, with a whole verse where everyone is lost [10]
- **Unbroken Chain** (1 other source): Uploader's first and only Unbroken Chain, at what was their final show [4]
- **Drums** (1 review): Reviewer notes Drums listed at 30 minutes and wonders about Mickey's reaction to Jerry [19]
- **Days Between** (1 review): Called a poignant version with a particularly soulful vocal from Jerry [12]

## The recordings

- **gd95-06-04.akg.2538.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 19 songs; 163 min; rated 2.6/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer suggests the audience recording's sound could be improved and a better take may exist [15]
- **gd1995-06-04.sennME40.sturtevant-swayne.85716.flac1648**: source not stated; 19 songs; 163 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Breeze common at Shoreline gets into this audience recording, causing occasional phasing-like fluctuations between channels [4]
- **gd95-06-04.sbd.13929.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 158 min; rated 2.69/5 by 28 [8]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears the band as bored and sloppy on this soundboard; Reviewer says the playing wasn't tight, with mistakes, and the tapes fail to capture the live feeling; Reviewer says the concert sounds great to them [9][13][14]
- **gd1995-06-04.141554.cmc4-mk41.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 19 songs; 164 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes this was the last Grateful Dead show in the Bay Area [10]
- Reviewer attended and notes this was the last Bay Area show [12]
- Attendee stood with a friend named Ron, grooving; it was their last Dead show [13]
- Attendee drove from Colorado through Nevada thunderstorms, camped at Half Moon Bay, and sat back on the lawn [14]
- Jerry's guitar shone silvery in the late afternoon sun; beachballs and a pre-show parking lot scene [14]
- Reviewer had sixth row center seats; the next day the FBI busted into their hotel room [18]
- Reviewer traveled from Baltimore by flight, bus, hitchhiking, BART and walking, reaching the lot at 6PM [20]
- Post says this was the Dead's final Shoreline performance and many fans' last time seeing them [26]
- Reviewer says Garcia's playing was worse here than in earlier years, with glimpses of genius rarer by 1995 [9]
- First set is rather good, while the second set is largely a shambles [10]
- Attendee found it even more painful than the Deer Creek show that year [12]
- Reviewer found the previous night serviceable but this show tougher [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd95-06-04.akg.2538.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jon Seff; source: Audience: AKG 522's [1]. Also: Uploader says a different source seems spliced in at Not Fade Away, continuing through Brokedown [1]
- **gd1995-06-04.sennME40.sturtevant-swayne.85716.flac1648**: taped by Neil Sturtevant and Others; transferred by Scott Swayne; source: Sennheiser K3U/ME40's > Panasonic sv255 > (clone) Teac DA-P20 [4]
- **gd95-06-04.sbd.13929.sbeok.shnf**: source: Sbd>C(x?)>CD via Chris Larson [8]
- **gd1995-06-04.141554.cmc4-mk41.ebel.flac1644**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16/44.1khz Source Info: FOB Schoeps CMC 4 MK 41-> Koch P/S-> Panasonic SV255-> DATTransfer Info: Dat Tape (Panasonic SV-3700)-> Marantz CDR-615-> CD (Late… [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Deadheadland: [The Grateful Dead’s final performance at Shoreline Amphitheatre, June 4, 1995](https://deadheadland.wordpress.com/2016/06/04/the-grateful-deads-final-performance-at-shoreline-amphitheatre-june-4-1995/) [27]
